If zero, stop; you can’t take this credit"; line 9, "Note: If line 9 is zero, stop; you can’t take this credit"; f8880 p. 2, Credit Limit Worksheet, line 3, "But if zero or less, stop; you can’t take the credit"; f8880 p. 1, Caution: "You cannot take this credit if either of the following applies. ... The person(s) who made the qualified contribution or elective deferral (a) was born after January 1, 2008; (b) is claimed as a dependent on someone else’s 2025 tax return; or (c) was a student". Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8880.deepseek.json`; 1,306 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026; 1,806 comparisons): 1,120 of 1,806 agree; 3 value, all on completed returns: witness 18 stage15.f8880.s1 (project 0.00, candidate 500.00, from the omitted Form 1099-R distributions on line 4(b)); witness 20 stage15.f8880-2.b15 (600.00 vs 1,453.00, same cause); witness 19 stage15.f8880.s13 (151.00 vs 0.00: one ineligible spouse bars the whole credit, the second reading of amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column, where the owner chose the per-column zero on line 6). 478 candidate-refuses on refused returns, 34 project-refuses on cited screens (person.sav_able, the line 8 refigure for excluded income, ftc.needs1116, person.plan_screened), 171 candidate-unknown (2 on completed returns). The Credit Limit Worksheet lines agree, including Schedule 3 line 3 in worksheet line 2.

Ruling: model error; f8880 p. 2, Line 4: "Enter the total amount of distributions you, and your spouse if filing jointly, received after 2022 and before the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions) from any of the following types of plans"; the types of plans include traditional and Roth IRAs and the employer plans of line 2, so 2025 distributions count. The candidate sums only person.sav_prior_joint (both roles) and the taxpayer's person.sav_prior_other and leaves out retirement.sav_amount, the 2025 Form 1099-R distributions. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8880.deepseek.json`; 1,306 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026; 1,806 comparisons): 1,654 of 1,806 agree; 120 value (32 on completed returns): witness 7 classm.ira.2 (completed, joint; project 28,257.00, candidate 0.00) and witness 11 classm.retirement.4 (completed, single; 34,952.00 vs 0.00). It also adds the taxpayer's sav_prior_joint on a return that is not joint, an input asked on a joint return only (witness 13, completed, candidate-unknown). The 30 project-refuses are the cited Form 1099-R screens retirement.bad_code and retirement.special (i1040gi p. 27; witnesses 0, 1, 5, 6, 8, 9), reached because the project reads the Forms 1099-R the candidate omits: scope. Witness 12 (stage10.ira.roth_code_unanswered) is an incomplete record.

Ruling: model error; as line 4(a), the candidate leaves out retirement.sav_amount, the 2025 Form 1099-R distributions (f8880 p. 2, Line 4: "Enter the total amount of distributions you, and your spouse if filing jointly, received after 2022 and before the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions) from any of the following types of plans"), and it has no joint-return guard (f8880 p. 2, Column (b): "Complete column (b) only if you’re filing a joint return"). Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8880.deepseek.json`; 1,306 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026; 1,806 comparisons): 1,613 of 1,806 agree; 12 value (7 on completed returns): witness 17 stage15.f8880.s1 (project 7,000.00, candidate 2,000.00), witness 5 classm.ira.2 (28,257.00 vs 0.00), witness 11 classm.tcw.15 (39,110.00 vs 0.00); 13 candidate-refuses and 162 candidate-unknown on records the project refuses or that withhold answers (2 unknowns on completed returns), its ABLE screen raised early; 6 project-refuses on the cited Form 1099-R screens (scope).
